payload.title: Pipe burst suspected
payload.summary: Pressure drop and flow mismatch on the Government District main.

payload.headline: Estimated leak of 140 m3/h on the Government main
payload.explanation: The Government District main is losing about 140 m3/h. Send a pipe repair crew now.
probableCauses: Pipe burst on the main segment

predictedImpact.text: Pressure in the Government District falls below 2.5 bar within 10 minutes.

recommendedAction.text: Isolate the segment and send a pipe repair crew

breakdown.label: Service disruption, zone-gov
breakdown.cause: Utility notification and customer-support administration in zone-gov

reasons.text: Pressure fell from 3.8 to 2.1 bar in 4 minutes
Inflow is 140 m3/h higher than outflow
Neighbouring sensors read normal, so this is not a sensor fault
Pump P-04 draw is up 12% as it compensates

inputs.name: Q_leak
inputs.basis: Synthetic twin measurement or baseline history; verify against calibrated SCADA/meter records before operational use.

inputs.name: P_water
inputs.basis: Illustrative marginal treatment and delivery cost, not a verified Egyptian tariff. Verify against the utility's water production cost ledger and supply contract.

inputs.name: customers_affected
inputs.basis: Planning service-account count scaled to the district demand in ZONE_BASE; residential accounts are households, institutional accounts are service connections, not people. Verify against the district occupancy and utility connection registers.

inputs.name: customer_hour_rate
inputs.basis: Illustrative government account-hour budget for notification and utility customer support only; excludes customer economic harm covered by VoLL. Verify against the utility support cost ledger and outage notification work orders.

inputs.name: outage_hours
inputs.basis: One outage hour establishes the hourly rate; the delay/response calculations apply the respective total hours once.

inputs.name: ΔE_secondary
inputs.basis: Synthetic extra purchased electricity in a dependent network; excludes unserved energy and primary-network excess consumption.

inputs.name: P_kWh
inputs.basis: Illustrative purchased-energy rate; Egyptian tariffs cannot be verified offline. Verify against the current electricity supply contract and invoices.

inputs.name: crew_callout
inputs.basis: Budget allowance for transport and emergency labour per dispatch. Verify against crew timesheets and the maintenance contractor rate card.

inputs.name: parts_pipe
inputs.basis: Budget for one district-main joint/section repair. Verify against the pipe bill of quantities and recent supplier quotations.
